# Vested KSA - Complete Information

## About Vested KSA
Vested is a Saudi Arabia-based operations and staffing partner that helps international companies establish and grow their presence in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Founded by experienced business leaders, Vested provides end-to-end support for company formation, operational setup, human resources management, financial and accounting services, legal compliance, and full operational outsourcing.

Vested operates exclusively in Saudi Arabia and has successfully guided 50+ international companies through market entry and establishment. Our typical setup timeline is 4-6 weeks, and clients typically save 40-60% compared to building their own infrastructure.

## Leadership
- Abdulkareem Alrammah: CEO and Co-founder
- Abdulaziz Khalid: Vice President and Co-founder

## Core Services

### Company Formation & Setup
- MISA licensing
- Commercial Registration with the Chamber of Commerce
- LLC or Branch office setup
- Initial business registration support
- Market entry planning and strategy

### Full Operational Outsourcing
- Administrative management and day-to-day operations
- Procurement and vendor management
- Facilities management and operations
- PRO services for government interactions
- Office management and coordination

### People & Human Resources
- Executive and professional recruitment
- Local and expatriate hiring
- Payroll management and processing
- Contract drafting and compliance
- Saudization (Nitaqat) compliance support
- Visa processing and immigration management
- Employee onboarding and training coordination

### Accounting & Finance
- VAT compliance and reporting
- Zakat calculation and filing
- Statutory audit support
- IFRS and SOCPA compliance
- Financial statement preparation and reporting
- Tax planning and optimization

### Legal & Compliance
- Regulatory compliance review and implementation
- Corporate governance support
- AML/KYC procedures
- Contract review and drafting
- Intellectual property registration and protection
- Dispute resolution coordination

### Workspace & Facilities
- Office space identification and selection
- Fit-out design and project management
- IT infrastructure setup and support
- Employee accommodation assistance
- Transportation and logistics coordination

## Why Choose Vested

### Local Expertise
Deep experience in the Saudi business environment with understanding of the regulatory landscape, cultural nuances, and practical operational challenges.

### Time to Market
Accelerates time to market with a typical setup timeline of 4-6 weeks instead of 6-12 months.

### Cost Efficiency
Companies typically save 40-60% compared to establishing their own facilities and managing regulatory compliance independently.

## Saudi Arabia Market Opportunity
Saudi Arabia represents a significant market opportunity with Vision 2030 initiatives creating new opportunities across sectors including technology, healthcare, finance, energy, and other key industries.
